profile.headline: AI Software Engineer | AI Agents, Developer Platforms & Automation
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built an internal AI-powered code review platform used across the firm, including the infrastructure that enables teams to onboard and deploy their own specialized code review agents. Developed the orchestration layer responsible for coordinating reviews, gathering relevant codebase context, and managing agent workflows.
- Helped develop an autonomous code migration workflow to accelerate legacy Sybase-to-SQL migrations. Built an agent loop that analyzes files and dependencies, generates code changes, runs tests, identifies errors, and iteratively fixes its own changes across large legacy codebases.
- Contributed to an AI-powered document intelligence platform for financial documents, capable of processing 100+ page prospectuses, term sheets, and other complex documents. Developed configurable extraction workflows that allow users to specify the information they need and automatically extract structured data from unstructured documents.

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description: At my final semester at Berkeley, I worked in the ESS space as a peer tutor. I spent most of my time during my shifts helping other undergraduate students with Berkeley classes such as the CS-61 series, Physics 7 series, Data 8, and Data 100. Tutoring consisted of looking over concepts, homework help, and preparing for exams.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: In my returning internship at Blackrock, I was part of a team revamping a full stack client facing application. Using angular was a welcomed addition to my UI skills alongside React, as well as industry API and a snowflake database.

positions.title: Front End Web Development Teaching Assistant
positions.description: As part of the education branch of Web Development at Berkeley, I, alongside the rest of WDB educators, was held responsible in introducing and educating new semester's cohort of students wanting to learn Web Development. Duties ranged from grading assignments, to creating new content/homework, and holding office hours to help any new student's questions.

positions.title: Manager Of Technology
positions.description: As a manager of technology at TedXBerkeley, I was in charge of managing the group website which included tasks such as updating new speakers, performers, and media. As well as ensuring the website live streams and app events went smoothly during the live performance.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: I was a part of the CoolClimate / EcoDatalab group at Berkeley led by Chris Jones and Daniel Kammen who are specializing in developing data and tools to help businesses, local governments and individuals identify the most promising opportunities to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: As a Software Engineering Intern for Blackrock I worked on the Aladdin Data layer team and helped in revamping/creating the backend and frontend for a repository viewer and developing a VSCode plugin.

positions.title: BAV Event Website Creator/Builder
positions.description: Position involves creating websites that act as portals for the Berkeley AV team, helping clients go through the creative process of getting their website tailored to their liking as I then design and create their website under their respective deadlines.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: Freelance Web Designer, using Figma to plan and design UX and UI specifications, while utilizing the Next.js framework to set up React Applications on the Web. A few of of my completed works include www.rtfilmhouse.com and www.ets.berkeley.edu

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description: Worked at Lowes, specializing in an influx of pandemic related services such as curbside pickup orders and integrating IBM software within the store's daily tasks. As well as creating an effective staff algorithm to handle overload of online orders.

positions.title: Fry Cook
positions.description: Worked at The Habit Burger Grill preparing food for customers and other kitchen duties. My main responsibilties included frying fries, grilling and preparing purgers, Evening and Morning food prep as well as other miscellaneous cleaning duties.

positions.title: Retail Sales Associate
positions.description:
Worked at a retail store position with a multitude of responsibilities including: 
Signing up customers up for credit cards and managing/paying their bills.
Keeping store inventory and discounts in compliance with store’s benchmarks.

positions.title: Shift Lead
positions.description: Worked at Little Caesars initially washing dishes and preparing pizzas for customers, but was promoted to Shift Lead. As Shift Lead I was responsible for taking inventory of several of the store's products as well as tracking cash register cash flow.

honors.title: BlackRock Hallac Scholar Finalist
honors.description: Currently participating in an interview round selection process, where best scholars from bay area universities are selected for internship from BlackRock for the 2021 year.

honors.title: People’s Choice Award
honors.description: A UC Berkeley Design Expo hosted by (PREP) and the College of Engineering. The Expo featured company representatives ranging from Google to Boeing and had those representatives judge various products and their real world applications, ultimately deciding on the a winner based on various criteria.
honors.issuer: Issued by Jacobs Design Expo · Aug 2019
